about_the_game:
oGANTTo
is a strategic deck-building game that puts you in the driver’s seat of a dynamic project management empire. Plan, adapt, and optimize to achieve victory by balancing resources, mastering economic techniques, and leading your team to success. Every decision counts—will you maximize revenue and efficiency, or will mismanagement lead to failure?

Key Features

Strategic Planning & Analysis
Dive into the heart of project management. Analyze your supply chain, evaluate resources, and choose the techniques that yield the highest returns. Every plan you craft shapes the flow of information, materials, and costs—set the course for success or risk falling behind.

Resource Management
Your workforce is your greatest asset. Deploy specialists and general labor strategically to boost productivity. Assign the right people to the right tasks to drive progress, but beware: inefficient use of employees can derail even the best-laid plans.

Master Economic Techniques
Unlock and apply real-world economic strategies to gain the edge. Schedule overtime, add extra shifts, hit critical milestones, or conduct customer visits to accelerate your progress. Each technique brings unique benefits and challenges—choose wisely to optimize your outcome.

Leadership Styles & Campaign Progression
Lead your team with distinct management philosophies:

  • Management by Results: Focus on outcomes and drive your team to meet ambitious targets.

  • Management by Objective: Set clear goals and align your workforce to achieve them.

  • Management by Motivation: Inspire your employees to unlock their full potential.
    Explore additional leadership approaches as you tackle increasingly complex campaigns. From small-scale projects to sprawling enterprises, each campaign ramps up the challenge and offers multiple paths to victory.

Dynamic Deck-Building
Build and refine your deck to reflect your management style. Combine resources, techniques, and leadership tactics to create synergies that propel your project forward. Experiment with different strategies to find the perfect balance between risk and reward.

A Game in Active Development

oGANTTo is being crafted with passion and care, and we’re excited to share its journey with you. Add it to your Steam Wishlist to stay updated on the latest developments, from new features to release milestones. Your support means the world to us!

Thank you for checking out oGANTTo! I’m thrilled to bring this unique blend of strategy and project management to life. Stay tuned for more updates, and let’s build something extraordinary together.

—Velemir, Developer

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

  • Storage: 200 MB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 3.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU / NVIDIA GeForce GTX750 or better
